# First Savvy — From Stars to Legacy

> The connected platform for family financial education, kids chore & allowance tracking, and holistic personal finance management.

## About First Savvy
First Savvy is a comprehensive family finance platform designed to bridge generational financial education with personal wealth management. It introduces children (ages 5–17) to real-world financial literacy through supervised star tasks, chore completion, and goal-oriented savings, while giving adults unified tools for net worth calculation, household budgeting, Plaid-connected accounts, financial calendars, and estate planning.

## Core Pillars & Modules

### 1. Family Financial Experience (Kids & Teens)
- **Supervised Child Spaces**: Dedicated PIN-protected or password-protected child views allowing kids to see assigned chores, redeem rewards, and set goal targets.
- **Star Reward Ledger**: An immutable star point accounting system where completed tasks translate to stars and rewards.
- **Allowance Automation**: Configurable weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly allowances with conditional chore completion thresholds.
- **COPPA Child Safety**: Built with strict compliance to the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), requiring verifiable parental consent with zero behavioral tracking or advertising on child profiles.

### 2. Personal & Household Finance (Adults)
- **True Net Worth Tracker**: Calculates assets (real estate, vehicles, cash, investments) minus liabilities (mortgages, credit cards, student loans).
- **Connected Budgets**: Visual planned vs. actual budget allocations with 50/30/20 guidance and smart category tracking.
- **Financial Calendar**: Interactive timeline of recurring subscriptions, bills, income deposits, and allowance payout dates.
- **Bank Connectivity**: Read-only bank synchronization powered by 256-bit encryption (Plaid Link in sandbox/live modes).
- **Estate & Document Vault**: High-security vault for important financial contacts, beneficiaries, and emergency documentation.

## Technical Architecture
- **Framework**: Next.js 14 (App Router)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS & Vanilla CSS design tokens with Dark/Light mode support
- **3D Graphics**: Interactive Three.js canvas components for particle star flows and financial globes
- **Data Persistence**: Offline-first Zustand client state with encrypted local storage and optional Supabase backend
